title: Find What Should Be Captured
text: The output contains open\_mouth and camera, so the regex should capture the emoji name inside the two colons, not the colons themselves.

title: Captured Text from One Emoji
text: For the emoji :open\_mouth:, what should the capturing group return?

title: Make the Repetition Part of the Capture
text: The + should apply inside the capturing group so the entire emoji name is captured. In r":(\w)+:", the group is repeated one character at a time, so it does not return the full emoji name.

title: Avoid Greedy Dot-Star
text: The pattern r":(.*):" uses .*, which can match any characters greedily. With multiple emojis, it can capture everything from the first colon to the last colon instead of separating the emojis.

title: Compare the Correct Patterns
text: The pattern `r":([a-zA-Z_]+):"` explicitly captures one or more letters or underscores between colons. The pattern `r":(\w+):"` also captures the full emoji names in these examples because \w includes letters and underscores.
